limitations: All fourteen selected body/action families are authored project sources. All action frames and native source sheets were visually reviewed; recorded native game observations remain scoped to their stage hashes. Some small human crests simplify at native scale. Complete moving-pose/in-game heraldry and original-HoMM3 visual compatibility acceptance remain pending. Historical comparison sheets below retain their own source cohorts.

reference.purpose: Private primary crest reference only; no redistribution grant inferred
reference.source: Riot official Data Dragon region imagery

required_native_target: Main crest approximately8–12pixels at native80–84pixel human scale; actual per-unit reductions are evidence, not acceptance. Small human chest marks remain unresolved.
required_placements: Existing cloth, shield, armor, instrument, codex or construct body; surface paint/engraving, no floating logo. Bases simpler paint/carving; upgrades engraved relief where appropriate.
required_shape: One upright broad pointed blade/leaf, downward-tapered stem and mirrored separated-feather wings. Generic trident/fleur-de-lys/wing-only marks are rejected.
status: authored configuration; all14 complete own action families compiled; final heraldry/visual acceptance pending
